P_s.formula: vp*vn/(vp+vn), 0 when vp+vn=0; valence=min absolute distance

Q_EI.domain: 2<=N,Z<=50; only used within the DZ correlated task domain
Q_EI.formula: product of u*(D-u)/D**2 for proton and neutron EI shells, u=count-lower, D=upper-lower; zero on every boundary

macros.radius_conversion: Sheng reports equivalent sharp R_C=sqrt(5/3)*r_rms; every Sheng expression here includes sqrt(3/5).

standard_valence.formula: Np/Nn = minimum absolute distance to proton/neutron boundaries; P=Np*Nn/(Np+Nn), zero when both zero
standard_valence.note: Spectroscopy domain N<=154,Z<=100 avoids dependence on unobserved upper-shell midpoints; boundaries are conventions, not universally established closures
